title: Fjord Coast
concept: Deep inlets in mirrored mainlands with a protected home headland, bay mouths and a shared fleet front.
difference_from_base: Mainland-indenting fjords and sheltered inlet fronts rather than offshore island obstacles.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams up to 4v4, west versus east.
routes: Explicit ports, common fleet front, ship access to each inlet, and amphibious access from home bases.
economy: Shared naval distribution with fixed opening spots, seabed expansions and general mex/geo controls.
known_weaknesses: Closely spaced inlets can share a mouth.
Advanced very deep mainland or narrow inlets can fail naval gameplay validation.
core_wishes: Requires the _naval.islands / finish helpers delivered in TPL-naval-fix-1.
